findings.summary: New headless API-key functions are not represented in checked-in generated Confect refs.
findings.details: S11-T02 adds a public/internal Confect contract consumed by the Settings route and HTTP auth path, but the checked-in generated Confect spec/ref artifacts do not include headless/apiKeys. The web route compensates with a local HeadlessApiKeyRefs type assertion over templateConfectRefs, so the client-hooks -> generated refs -> Confect specs contract is asserted rather than enforced by generated contract evidence at this head.

findings.summary: Uniform external failure contract omits RateLimited from the headless HTTP result types.
findings.details: The task packet explicitly requires uniform external Unauthorized | Forbidden | ValidationFailed | RateLimited, but the implemented route/helper/executor failure unions expose only Unauthorized, Forbidden, ValidationFailed, and NotFound. There is no RateLimited envelope path in the headless HTTP contract files inspected, so one declared external failure remains unreachable and untyped.
